units.summary: New test helper that picks `count` refs at evenly spaced positions in a slice. If `count` is at least the slice length, it returns a copy of the whole slice. It is only used by benchmarks.
units.headline: Add benchmark helper that samples refs at even intervals

units.summary: New benchmark that times filterSeriesAndSortPostings with the isSeriesWithoutOOO predicate. Input sizes vary over a 100k-series head. It is test-only code.
units.headline: Add benchmark for filterSeriesAndSortPostings across input fractions
units.reason: New benchmark in a _test.go file; no production effect.

units.summary: staleIndex is renamed to selectedSeriesIndex and now builds a headSelectedSeriesIndexReader from the generic seriesRefs type. The construction logic is the same as before.
units.headline: Rename staleIndex to selectedSeriesIndex using generic seriesRefs
units.reason: Rename of an unexported method; it now also backs the new selected-series compaction path.

units.headline: Rename stale index reader type to selected-series index reader
units.reason: Unexported type rename with all uses updated; it is now reused for arbitrary ref lists.

units.summary: Receiver and field are renamed; it still intersects the head postings with the selected refs list. The logic is unchanged.

units.reason: Pure rename of an unexported type with all uses updated in this PR; the fields are the same.

units.summary: The old stale-series collection loop is generalised into filterSeriesAndSortPostings, which takes any postings and an optional keep predicate. The predicate is checked while holding the series lock. Results come back in input order and in label order. CompactSelectedSeries now feeds it caller-supplied, possibly unsorted refs.

issues.title: Caller refs are not deduplicated or sorted before building the index view
issues.evidence:
sortedByRef = append(sortedByRef, ref)
keptSeries = append(keptSeries, s)
...
slices.SortFunc(keptSeries, ...)
issues.failure_scenario: If CompactSelectedSeries([]SeriesRef{r, r}) is called, sortedByLabels lists the same series twice. The block index writer is then fed duplicate label sets, which likely makes the compaction fail. Unsorted input also leaves sortedByRef unsorted, but it is passed to ListPostings/Intersect, which expect sorted postings.

units.headline: Generalise stale-series lookup into predicate-based filter and label sort
units.reason: Core filtering logic changes and now handles arbitrary caller refs for a public compaction API.
focus: Duplicate or unsorted refs passed to CompactSelectedSeries reaching the index writer via sortedByLabels
Whether the index reader paths that use sortedByRef with ListPostings/Intersect assume sorted refs
Calling labels() without the series lock after filtering (same as before)

units.summary: Now delegates to filterSeriesAndSortPostings over all postings, with the predicate isSeriesWithoutOOO && isStaleSeries. That matches the old inline checks for OOO data and stale NaN, evaluated under the series lock.
units.headline: Stale-series ref lookup now delegates to generic filter helper
units.reason: Equivalent refactor: same predicates, same lock, same output shape.
